texts: The city council met on Thursday evening to discuss the new traffic plan. After three hours of debate, the councillors approved the proposal by a narrow majority. The plan will come into effect in January.

The museum, which had been closed since the earthquake of 2016, reopened its doors last week. Visitors queued for hours to see the restored frescoes. The director said that the restoration had cost more than four million euros.

Heavy rain hit the north of the country over the weekend. Several rivers burst their banks, and hundreds of people had to leave their homes. The government has declared a state of emergency in two regions.

The company was founded in 1950 by a young engineer from Turin. In the following decades it became one of the largest manufacturers of household appliances in Europe. Today it employs more than 20,000 people worldwide.

Scientists have discovered that a species of bird thought to be extinct still survives on a remote island. The researchers had been searching for it for almost ten years. They found a small colony of about forty birds.

The trial of the former mayor began on Monday. He is accused of having accepted bribes from construction companies between 2010 and 2015. His lawyers say that he is innocent and that he will be acquitted.
The castle stands on a hill overlooking the valley. It was built in the twelfth century and was enlarged several times over the following centuries. Today it houses a museum of medieval art.
The national team lost the match 2-0 on Saturday night. The coach admitted that his players had not played well. The team will face Spain in the next round.

The writer was born in a small village in Calabria in 1921. She moved to Rome after the war and worked as a journalist for many years. Her first novel was published in 1958 and was an immediate success.

Prices rose by 0.3 percent in October compared with the previous month. Energy and food prices continued to increase, while the cost of clothing fell slightly. Economists expect inflation to slow down next year.

The volcano erupted on Tuesday morning, sending a column of ash several kilometres into the sky. Flights were cancelled at the nearby airport. Experts said that the volcano had been showing signs of activity for weeks.
The bridge had been closed for two years when the authorities finally approved the funds for its reconstruction. Work will begin in the spring and is expected to last eighteen months.
The police arrested two men on Friday in connection with the robbery of a jewellery shop. The two suspects had been under surveillance for several weeks. A third man is still being sought.
The festival takes place every year in the first week of August. It attracts thousands of visitors from all over Europe. This year's edition will feature more than fifty concerts.
The ancient city was founded by the Greeks in the seventh century BC. It later became an important Roman colony. Its ruins were rediscovered in the eighteenth century.

The minister announced that the government would invest in renewable energy. The plan includes the construction of new solar and wind farms. Environmental groups welcomed the decision but said it was not enough.
The hospital has been treating patients from the whole region since it opened in 1985. Last year it carried out more than 10,000 operations. A new wing will be inaugurated next month.
The strike had been going on for three weeks when the company finally agreed to negotiate. The workers are demanding higher wages and better working conditions. The talks will begin on Monday.
Leonardo spent the last years of his life in France, where he had been invited by the king. He died in 1519 at the castle of Amboise. Many of his notebooks were later dispersed.
The new railway line will connect the two cities in less than an hour. Construction began in 2018 and should be completed by 2027. The project has been criticised for its high cost.
The island has a mild climate and is popular with tourists all year round. Its beaches are among the most beautiful in the Mediterranean. In the interior, there are small villages and vineyards.
The singer cancelled her concert at the last minute because of illness. Her fans, who had been waiting outside the theatre for hours, were disappointed. The concert will take place next month.
The government fell after the parliament rejected the budget. The president will now consult the party leaders. New elections could be held in the spring.
The monastery was founded in the tenth century by a group of monks from France. For centuries it was a centre of learning and culture. It was abandoned after the Napoleonic wars.
The company reported a loss of 200 million euros for the year. The chief executive blamed the high cost of energy and the decline in demand. The shares fell by eight percent.
The fire broke out in the early hours of the morning. Firefighters had been fighting the flames for several hours when the roof collapsed. Nobody was injured.
The study found that children who read every day perform better at school. The researchers followed more than 3,000 pupils for five years. The results were published in a scientific journal.
The old town is surrounded by medieval walls. Its narrow streets are lined with shops, cafés and restaurants. The cathedral, built in the thirteenth century, dominates the main square.
The two countries signed a trade agreement on Wednesday. The agreement will reduce tariffs on agricultural products. It had been under negotiation since 2019.
The athlete won her third gold medal of the championships. She had been training for this event for four years. After the race, she dedicated her victory to her family.
Rescue workers found the missing child on Sunday afternoon. The boy had been lost in the woods for two days. He was taken to hospital, but his condition is not serious.
The library contains a valuable collection of manuscripts. Some of them date back to the ninth century. Scholars from all over the world come to study them.
The unemployment rate fell to 7.5 percent in September. It is the lowest level since 2008. The government said that the reforms were starting to produce results.
The ship left the port of Genoa on Monday morning. It was carrying more than 2,000 passengers. The cruise will last ten days and will stop in five countries.
The president visited the areas affected by the earthquake. He promised that the state would help the families who had lost their homes. Reconstruction will take several years.
The painter lived and worked in Venice for most of his life. His paintings are known for their bright colours and their depictions of the lagoon. Many of them are now in museums abroad.
The road was blocked for several hours after a lorry overturned. The driver was slightly injured. Traffic returned to normal in the evening.
The university was founded in 1088 and is considered the oldest in the Western world. Today it has more than 80,000 students. It offers courses in almost every discipline.
The negotiations had been dragging on for months when the two sides finally reached an agreement. The deal will be signed next week in Brussels.
The film tells the story of a family of fishermen in a small town in Sicily. It was shot entirely on location. It won several awards at international festivals.
Doctors are warning about the dangers of the heat. They advise people to drink plenty of water and to avoid going out in the hottest hours of the day. Elderly people are especially at risk.
The factory had been producing cars since 1930 when it was closed in 2012. The site has since been converted into a technology park. More than a hundred companies now work there.
The archaeologists discovered a Roman villa during the construction of a new road. The villa contains well-preserved mosaics and frescoes. The excavation will continue for several months.
The team had not won a match for two months when the new coach arrived. Under his leadership, the club won six of its next eight games. The fans are now hoping for promotion.
The government has introduced a new tax on plastic packaging. The measure is intended to reduce waste. Industry groups say it will increase prices for consumers.
The poet wrote most of his works in exile. He had left his country after the coup of 1973. He returned only after the fall of the dictatorship, in 1990.
The tourist season has started well, with hotels reporting high occupancy rates. Foreign visitors, especially from the United States, are returning in large numbers. The beaches are already crowded.
The landslide destroyed several houses and cut off the village from the rest of the valley. Residents had been warning the authorities about the danger for years. An investigation has been opened.
The orchestra will perform Beethoven's Ninth Symphony on New Year's Eve. The concert will be broadcast live on television. Tickets sold out in a few hours.
The company has been working on the new engine since 2020. It promises to reduce fuel consumption by a third. The first cars equipped with it will go on sale next year.
The prime minister met the leaders of the opposition on Tuesday. They discussed the reform of the electoral law. No agreement was reached, but the talks will continue.
The village had been without a school for ten years when the council decided to open a new one. The building was inaugurated in September. It has forty pupils.
The emperor ruled for almost forty years. During his reign, the empire reached its greatest extent. He was remembered as one of the greatest rulers in its history.
The patient had been waiting for a heart transplant for two years. The operation took place on Saturday night and lasted eight hours. The doctors said it was a success.
The river flows through the city from north to south. Several bridges connect the two banks. The oldest of them dates back to the Roman period.
The government says that the new law will protect consumers. Critics argue that it will create more bureaucracy. The parliament will vote on it next month.
The explorer set off from the coast in March with a small group of men. They had been walking for six weeks when they reached the source of the river. Only half of them returned.
The price of coffee has risen sharply this year because of a poor harvest in Brazil. Many cafés have increased their prices. Consumers are not happy.
The children were playing in the square when the earthquake struck. Fortunately, nobody was hurt. Many old buildings were damaged.
The museum has acquired a painting that had been in a private collection for more than a century. The work will be exhibited from next spring. Experts consider it a masterpiece.
